newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market slow Friday - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market slow Friday - USDA.

text.p: Trade slow on Friday morning, according to USDA. Steers and heifers were not established on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights).
Dressed Basis Steers - No confirmed sales.
Dressed Basis Heifers - No confirmed sales.
Prices were not fully established on slaughter steers or heifers. Buyer inquiry and demand rather light. Seller interest light.

Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Slaughter Steers - No confirmed sales. Slaughter Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1125 lbs 70.00. Sales confirmed - 500 For the week - None.
